entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Prince Louis Thomas of Savoy-Carignano was a Count of Soissons, bearing from birth an honorary princely title in the cadet line of the House of Savoy. He was killed as Feldzeugmeister of the Imperial Army at the Siege of Landau at the start of the War of the Spanish Succession.
